page_topic_one_liner: Agent-native git hosting — agent-scale forges, high-frequency PR throughput, mirror/migration, and collaboration boundaries for AI coding agents
differentiator_vs_generic: This is code forge infrastructure for agent-scale commits and PRs (Origin, GitLab next-gen, Agent HQ), NOT an AI coding assistant tutorial, NOT code review tool comparison alone. Hero must show parallel agent branches, burst commit graph, and forge mirror sync — the hosting layer bottleneck visual.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Agent-scale git forge — dense parallel branch lanes with many small commit dots (high frequency), 3 stacked PR cards with merge-queue blur status badges
Mirror sync arrows between two forge silhouettes (incumbent ↔ agent-scale beta)
Secondary: commit velocity spike graph showing agent load vs human baseline dotted line
anti_patterns: Generic GitHub Octocat or trademark logo
Code review comment thread without forge/branch context
AI chat panel unrelated to repository hosting
